'''Kelm Hargunth''' is an [[orc]] PvP rewards vendor located at [[Mor'shan Base Camp]] in the [[Barrens]]. He is the supply officer for the [[Warsong Outriders]].

==Quests==
*{{questlong|Horde|34|Outrider Basic Care Package (quest)|Outrider Basic Care Package}} {{queststartfinish}}
*{{questlong|Horde|44|Outrider Standard Care Package (quest)|Outrider Standard Care Package}} {{queststartfinish}}
*{{questlong|Horde|60|Outrider Advanced Care Package (quest)|Outrider Advanced Care Package}} {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Zug zug, my friend! I am Kelm Hargunth, the main supplier for the Warsong Outriders. As you improve your standing with the Outriders, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you can use inside [[Warsong Gulch]]. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
